name: shinchantw_cbt_guide_join_diagnostic_20260729_160155_555313
sql:
WITH NewRoles AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "#distinct_id" AS distinct_id, "$part_date" AS role_date
    FROM ta.v_event_18
    WHERE "$part_date" BETWEEN '2026-07-29' AND '2026-07-29'
      AND "$part_event" = 'new_role'
      AND "#distinct_id" IS NOT NULL
),
Guides AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "#distinct_id" AS distinct_id, "$part_date" AS guide_date
    FROM ta.v_event_18
    WHERE "$part_date" BETWEEN '2026-07-29' AND '2026-07-29'
      AND "$part_event" = 'gamer_guide'
      AND "#distinct_id" IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT distinct_id) FROM NewRoles) AS "创角设备",
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT distinct_id) FROM Guides) AS "引导设备",
    COUNT(DISTINCT n.distinct_id) AS "同设备同日匹配",
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN n.distinct_id IS NOT NULL THEN g.distinct_id END) AS "匹配引导设备"
FROM Guides g
LEFT JOIN NewRoles n
  ON g.distinct_id = n.distinct_id
 AND g.guide_date = n.role_date;
